title: DPMA: Learning to Compress Mixture-of-Experts Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.27759v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures offer high computational efficiency, but storing all experts requires substantial memory and limits deployment on resource-constrained hardware. Most retraining-free MoE compression methods commit to either pruning or merging experts, often with a uniform compression ratio across layers. We introduce DPMA (Differentiable Prune Merge Absorb), which jointly learns compression operations and layer-wise expert allocation through gradient descent under a global expert budget. Separate learnable coefficients allow DPMA to prune experts, merge their parameters, and absorb their routing contributions by forwarding routing weights to retained experts. These coefficients and expert assignments are optimised to match the original model's outputs on calibration data while its weights remain frozen. translated_title: DPMA：学习压缩混合专家模型
translated_abstract: 混合专家架构具有很高的计算效率，但存储所有专家需要大量内存，限制了其在资源受限硬件上的部署。大多数无需重新训练的 MoE 压缩方法只选择专家剪枝或专家合并中的一种方式，且通常在各层采用统一的压缩率。我们提出了 DPMA（可微分剪枝-合并-吸收，Differentiable Prune Merge Absorb），它在全局专家预算约束下，通过梯度下降联合学习压缩操作和逐层的专家分配。借助各自独立的可学习系数，DPMA 能够剪枝专家、合并其参数，并通过将路由权重前向传递给保留的专家来吸收其路由贡献。这些系数和专家分配在保持模型权重冻结的情况下，通过在校准数据上匹配原始模型的输出进行优化。在四个 MoE 模型、八个多选基准测试和五种压缩率上，DPMA 取得了最高的准确率……
tldr: DPMA 提出了一种无需重新训练的可微分压缩方法，在全局专家预算下联合学习专家剪枝、参数合并、路由吸收三种操作及逐层的专家分配策略，从而在多个 MoE 模型和压缩率下取得了最优的压缩效果。
en_tdlr: DPMA is a retraining-free differentiable compression method that jointly learns expert pruning, parameter merging, and routing absorption, along with layer-wise expert allocation under a global expert budget, achieving superior compression performance across MoE models and compression ratios.
